# commercetools_checkout_payment_integration (Resource)

A payment method offered by a commercetools Checkout application, handled by a payment connector deployed with commercetools Connect, such as the Adyen or Stripe connector. The connector's deployment is a `commercetools_connect_deployment`; its `type` values come from that connector.

See also the [Payment Integrations documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/payment-integrations-api).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_checkout_payment_integration" "card" {
  key                   = "adyen-card"
  application_id        = commercetools_checkout_application.shop.id
  connect_deployment_id = commercetools_connect_deployment.adyen.id
  name                  = "Adyen card"
  type                  = "card"
  component_type        = "Component"
  status                = "Active"
  predicate             = "country='NL' or country='BE'"
  sort_priority         = 1

  label = {
    en = "Credit card"
    nl = "Creditcard"
  }

  automated_reversal = "Active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the `commercetools_checkout_application` that offers it. Changing it replaces the payment integration.
- `component_type` (String) `Component`, `DropIn` or `Express`. Checkout offers it only when it matches the application's `active_payment_component_type`. Changing it replaces the payment integration.
- `connect_deployment_id` (String) ID of the `commercetools_connect_deployment` of the payment connector that handles it. Changing it replaces the payment integration.
- `name` (String) Name of the payment integration in the Merchant Center.
- `type` (String) Payment method as the payment service provider and its connector name it, such as `card`, `paypal` or `applepay`; `drop-in` for a `DropIn` integration.

### Optional

- `automated_reversal` (String) `Active` to reverse a payment automatically when the order cannot be placed, or `Inactive`. Defaults to `Inactive`, as Checkout sets it.
- `automated_reversal_predicate` (String) JSONata predicate on the cart deciding when a payment is reversed automatically. Requires `automated_reversal`.
- `description` (Map of String) Description shown to the customer, by locale.
- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the payment integration.
- `label` (Map of String) Name shown to the customer, by locale.
- `logo_url` (Map of String) URL of the logo shown to the customer, by locale.
- `pay_button_text` (Map of String) Text on the pay button, by locale.
- `predicate` (String) JSONata predicate on the cart deciding when it is offered, such as `country='NL'`. Only for `Component` integrations.
- `sort_priority` (Number) Position among the application's payment methods.
- `status` (String) `Active` or `Inactive`. Defaults to `Inactive`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the payment integration.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the payment integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A payment integration is imported using its id.
terraform import commercetools_checkout_payment_integration.card 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
